description: Rail profile on main tracks is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Infrabel. Kilometres of main tracks by rail profile since 2006. On main tracks, one usually finds profiles 50E2(50 kg per metre) and 60E1 (60 kg per metre).In the gradual rail renewal in main tracks, the old profiles are replaced by the profile 60E1. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are Hoofdsporen, Sporen. The portal shows 60 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-07-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
